name: case-slider
description: Customer story slider: centred heading over one story at a time (quote, author, link beside a photo with an optional client logo), arrows, a progress line and dots. Live: the #ap-<page>-case section (.apg-case-*) on the solution pages and Help Desk, and #ap-gov-case on the industry hubs (sheets and markup ported).

variant.description: solution: the six solution pages (View All sits in the controls row). service: Help Desk (View All sits centred under the controls). hub: the Government and Healthcare hubs (wordmark logo badges; View All ends the controls row). hub-industry: the Construction and Manufacturing hubs (their own sheet: fixed 120x80 logo badge, quotes keep 18px on phones).

quote_icon.description: Quote mark image. Empty uses the kit's own.

items.description: Stories. Each: quote (required); title (headline), author, role, link_label, link_url, image, image_alt, logo, logo_alt; hub variants also logo_w / logo_h (logo size in px) and logo_text (a wordmark badge instead of a logo image; *starred* text is set bold) with logo_style (hospice, osage or fresenius).

viewall_label.description: Link to all stories. Renders only with viewall_url.
